worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.summary: Fires a burst of unpleasant sound for special damage and leaves the target unable to recover HP through moves, Abilities or held items for a while.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.use.0: Shut down an opponent's healing and recovery
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.use.1: Punish a foe that leans on recovery
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.descripti: The hit deals special damage at %1$s base power and blocks all HP recovery from moves, Abilities and held items for %2$s.
Sound-wave range %1$s blocks, speed %2$s blocks/tick, collision radius %3$s blocks.
prepare %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.pierce.on: Piercing screech: the wave passes through up to 4 targets, at the cost of x0.8 power and a x0.85 block duration.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.pierce.of: Focused: a single target, with stronger power and a longer block.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.growth.0: At level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the block extends to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicnoise.preferenc: On (Piercing): the wave passes through up to 4 targets, but power is x0.8 and the block x0.85. Off (Focused): one target, with stronger power and a longer block.
Psychic Noise is considered only within this distance; a larger value blocks recovery from farther away.
